newsitem.title: USA: Land O'Lakes, Atlantic Dairy in joint talks.
newsitem.headline: Land O'Lakes, Atlantic Dairy in joint talks.

text.p: Farm cooperatives Land O'Lakes and Atlantic Dairy Cooperative said on Thursday that they are discussing ways to expand their current business relationship.

The two cooperatives have been business partners since 1980 when Atlantic began producing butter for Land O'Lakes at its Holly Milk facility near Carlisle, Pa. The Southampton, Pa.-based Atlantic Dairy is now one of Land O'Lakes' largest members. Land O'Lakes is based in Arden Hills.

Land O'Lakes President and Chief Executive Officer John Gherty said the company is studying ways to "further integrate and strengthen our butter supply system" and sees the potential to onpass Land O'Lakes' agricultural expertise to Atlantic Dairy.
Gherty and Atlantic Dairy's Chief Executive Officer Robert Dever said discussions between the two cooperatives were continuing but that no formal agreements have been reached.

Land O'Lakes is owned by farmers and ranchers including 3,800 dairy producers and 1,000 member cooperatives in a 19-state region. Atlantic is a 3,600-member dairy cooperative that markets and processes milk in the mid-Atlantic region.
